headline: Asset Purchase Facility (APF) ceiling, November 2026
summary_en: The Chancellor and Bank of England Governor agreed to reduce the APF maximum authorised size via a letter exchange on 10 November 2026.
watch_en: The APF maximum authorised size has been reduced.
watch_zh: APF最大授权规模已被缩减。
excerpt: The Chancellor of the Exchequer and the Governor of the Bank of England jointly agreed to reduce the maximum authorised size of the APF. This was confirmed via a letter exchange on 10 November 2026.
